turns.instruction:
Build the 5 m fixed-base spatial column with a real rigidly connected 1 m beam extending along global +X at its top. The arm tip carries global Fy=+10 kN and Fz=-200 kN. A connected column node at Z=2.5 m separately carries global Fx=+16 kN. Report armTip Ux/Uy/Uz and base global support My/Mz for D.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Change only the arm geometry from 1 m along +X to 1 m along +Y: armTip becomes (0,1,5) m. Retain the global arm-tip load vector Fy=+10, Fz=-200 kN and the column-midpoint +X 16 kN. Recompute armTip Ux/Uy/Uz and base My/Mz.

Undo only the preceding arm geometry change, restoring armTip=(1,0,5) m and the original arm orientation. Keep both force vectors and column height unchanged. Recompute armTip Ux/Uy/Uz and base My/Mz.
